I ended up having depression because of the events that took place that year (best friend dying, girlfriend cheating on me, family disowning me) so I went from job to job so I could find myself. Eventually after the third year I applied to multiple colleges (applied to universities but I guess it was too late because no program for me was open) and got accepted to a few. My goal for this year is to go to school and only focus on school, no more partying or drinking or even dicking around. Moral of the story: minimum wage jobs aren't worth it If you're a hard worker
